title: Queen Bedroom/Hot Tub/Posh Home
description:
Posh Queen Room with hot tub, 10 minutes to downtown.  
Smart Lock Check In
Fast Wi-Fi and 54" TV,
Desk, USB outlets.
Renovated kitchen and shared bath.
Free on-site parking spaces off street.
2 Miles from East Nashville eats and spots.  
Native Superhost ready to help!
Book now-dates fill fast!

The space
The guest room has a comfy Queen bed and bedding, windows with linen Roman shades, closet and dresser storage, and a large TV with access to DirectTV, Netflix, Amazon Video, Hulu, and CBS All Access.  There is also a desk and chair, iron, ironing board, snacks and bottled water.  There is a train that runs behind the property with quiet restrictions at night for the neighborhood.

Guest access
Check yourself in with a keypad lock.  Make yourself at home.  You are welcome to use any of the shared living spaces including the living room, kitchen, sitting areas on the front and back porches, the hot tub and the large back yard with a fire pit.

During your stay
I’m available for any questions you may have;  this is a welcoming, open and accepting home.  Feel free to interact as much or as little as you like.

Other things to note
New hot tub installed!  If you feel like exercise, Planet Fitness is just a few blocks away.  And the neighborhood is great for walks or runs.  I have yoga mats and blankets available also.
